decision_rule.D2_model_extrapolates_below_floor: co it nhat 1 du bao tho < 0 tren TRAIN hoac VALIDATION

mathematical_argument: Voi thuc te y >= 0 va san b = 0: |y - max(0, y_hat)| <= |y - y_hat| voi MOI gia tri y_hat. Chung minh: neu y_hat >= 0 thi hai ve bang nhau; neu y_hat < 0 thi |y - 0| = y va |y - y_hat| = y - y_hat > y. => cat ve san khong bao gio lam tang sai so tuyet doi o bat ky dong nao. Day la phep chieu dung dac nhanh khong phai sieu tham so fit tu du lieu.

reporting_convention.raw_model: Ridge(alpha=0.001, solver=lsqr) — metric cua MO HINH la day. Day la con so duoc bao cao trong evaluation_results.json va la ket luan chinh thuc cua bao cao.
reporting_convention.deployed_predictor: max(0, Ridge) — mot WRAPPER phuc vu, KHONG phai mot mo hinh khac. Metric cua no chi duoc bao cao rieng va khong duoc goi cung ten voi metric cua mo hinh.
reporting_convention.explicitly_not_a_claim: Policy KHONG duoc chon vi thay so duong am tren FINAL TEST. Evidence chi lay tu TRAIN + VALIDATION; FINAL TEST chi duoc bao cao sau khi policy da dong bang de minh bach.
